fields.name: save_magic
fields.description: Save header magic 'HAMPARA_GBA 00A_' (HAMPARA = Hamster Paradise), first EEPROM table entries
fields.evidence: Logical-domain (rev8) bytes 0x00-0x0F read 'HAMPARA_GBA 00A_'; raw file bytes are bit-reversed per 8B block. Written by grouped EEPROM transfer FUN_080089b8 (8-byte words via FUN_08052da0 write / FUN_08052bbc read, ops 0/1/2/3) as the first table entries.

fields.name: save_counter
fields.description: Per-save incrementing counter byte, copied from save-state byte +0xb into record byte 0
fields.evidence: FUN_080080c4 writes record byte0 from state byte +0xb (*(DAT_0800810c)+0x1c buffer); FUN_08007fb8 increments DAT_0800808c[0xb] on every save commit. Fresh baseline value 0x00.

fields.name: header_xor
fields.description: Record validation byte: XOR of save-state bytes +2 and +3
fields.evidence: FUN_080080c4 sets record byte1 to *(state+2) ^ *(state+3) before the 6-word checksum loop. Fresh baseline value 0x00.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.description: Custom 12-byte-record checksum word: stored = ~sum(other 5 words) - 8, i.e. whole-record word sum == 0xFFF7 (-9). Custom algorithm, not in Schema v2 list, so stored as plain u16.
fields.evidence: FUN_080080c4 sums 6 u16 words with stored word zeroed then stores ~sum-8 at record+2; FUN_08008114 validates each record with (sum of 6 words == -9). Fresh baseline value 0x0000 (record not yet checksummed).

fields.name: record_payload_a
fields.description: First payload word of the 12-byte save record (CpuSet-copied record bytes +4..+7)
fields.evidence: FUN_080080c4 CpuSets (FUN_08052994 = SWI CpuSet) record bytes +4.. into the save buffer (ROM defaults from DAT_08008110). Fresh baseline value 0x00000000.

fields.name: status_flags
fields.description: Packed status flags built from save-state bytes +2/+3/+7/+8 and mode bits (bits 0x80, 0x1000, 0x2000 observed)
fields.evidence: FUN_08007fb8 packs DAT_0800808c bytes +2,+3,+7,+8 into a status u16: bit7 set when byte0==8, 0x1000 when byte7!=0, 0x2000 when (mode&0x3f)>>4>1, bit15 from byte8>>3. Fresh baseline value 0x0000.

fields.name: mode_bits
fields.description: Mode/state word tested against masks 0x300/0x1000/0x2000/0x8000 with 2-bit submode in bits 0-1
fields.evidence: FUN_08008664 tests *(DAT_08008698+4) against 0x300, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x8000 and merges (value&3) into the option byte. Fresh baseline value 0x0000.

fields.name: option_byte
fields.description: Option/state byte: keeps bits 0x50, sets 0x10/0x04/0x80|submode per game state
fields.evidence: FUN_08008664 reads/writes DAT_08008698+1 with mask 0x50 kept and sets 0x10, 0x04, or 0x84|(mode&3) depending on state-word tests. Fresh baseline value 0x00.

fields.name: play_counter
fields.description: Small counter capped at 0x10 (16) in save-state handling
fields.evidence: FUN_08008664 only increments *(DAT_08008698+0x18) while it is <= 0x10; FUN_080081c0 manages related record bytes +0x14..0x18. Fresh baseline value 0x00 satisfies 0..16.

fields.name: extended_data_lo
fields.description: Extended save-region data word (EEPROM word 0x186), written by grouped transfer; dual-region layout matches the two-record save/load path
fields.evidence: Game-written zero word at logical 0x0C30 (EEPROM word 0x186) via FUN_080089b8 grouped transfer dispatched by FUN_08008848 (param_1 group accumulation); second-region layout consistent with the two 0x10-byte slot records validated in FUN_08008114 (called from save commit FUN_08007fb8). Fresh baseline value 0x00000000.

fields.name: extended_data_hi
fields.description: Extended save-region data word 2 (EEPROM word 0x186 high half)
fields.evidence: Game-written zero word at logical 0x0C34 via FUN_080089b8 grouped transfer (FUN_08008848 dispatcher); see extended_data_lo. Fresh baseline value 0x00000000.
